name: Fastener Library
blurb: screw, nut and washer sizes by head type, with CAD variables
intro: Pick a metric size and head type and get the head, nut and washer dimensions from the ISO/DIN standards, the clearance hole and counterbore or countersink, the screw length to order for your grip, and the numbers as CAD variables.

inputs.label: Clamped thickness (grip)
inputs.help: Thickness of the parts the screw passes through, without washers.

examples.title: M3 socket head into aluminium through a 6 mm plate
M5 button head with a nyloc nut through 10 mm

usage: Give size (M1.6-M16), head (socket, button, countersunk, pan, hex), nut (none, hex, nyloc), for nut=none the material tapped into (steel, castiron, aluminium, plastic), the grip in mm and whether washers are used. It returns head diameter and height, drive, ISO 273 clearance hole, counterbore or countersink, nut and washer sizes, the length needed and the standard length to order, and a 'CAD variables' text with all of them in mm. Use it when modelling holes and pockets for a screw joint.
sources: ISO 4762, ISO 7380-1, ISO 10642, ISO 7045, ISO 4017 (screw heads)
Thread engagement lengths and nut protrusion: rule of thumb (VDI 2230 / Machinery's Handbook practice)
